+    (B S : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) (T : Sheaf K RingCat.{r})
+    (hB : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : B.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hS : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : S.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hT : ∀ (U : Dᵒᵖ) (a b : T.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (a : B ⟶ S)
+    (p : T ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{r} K J).obj B)
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} B)]
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} S)]
+    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r} T)] :
+    ∃ RG : RightImage (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{r} p),

+        IsIso (RG.unit.app
+          (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{r} a).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)) := by
+  obtain ⟨OB, rfl⟩ := CategoryTheory.coefficientCommRingSheaf B hB
+  obtain ⟨OS, rfl⟩ := CategoryTheory.coefficientCommRingSheaf S hS
+  obtain ⟨OT, rfl⟩ := CategoryTheory.coefficientCommRingSheaf T hT
+  let φ : OT ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{r} K J).obj OB :=
+    ⟨{ app := fun U ↦ CommRingCat.ofHom (p.hom.app U).hom
+       naturality := by
+         intro U V g
+         apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
+         exact congrArg RingCat.Hom.hom (p.hom.naturality g) }⟩
+  let L := F.sheafPullback (Type r) K J
+  let adj := F.sheafAdjunctionContinuous (Type r) K J
+  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits L := by
+    dsimp only [L]
+    letI : HasSheafify K (Type r) := inferInstance
+    letI : HasSheafify J (Type r) := inferInstance
+    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (F.op.lan : (Dᵒᵖ ⥤ Type r) ⥤ Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type r) :=
+      CategoryTheory.lan_preservesFiniteLimits_of_flat (Type r) F
+    exact Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.preservesFiniteLimits F (Type r) K J
+  let g := CategoryTheory.siteContinuousRingedTopos F L adj OB OT φ
+  have H := CategoryTheory.coefficientAcyclicDerived _ _ _ hB hS hT a g
+  have hp : (sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).map φ = p := by
+    ext U x
+    rfl
+  dsimp only [g, CategoryTheory.siteContinuousRingedTopos] at H
+  obtain ⟨RG, η, hRG, hI, hS'⟩ := H
+  exact ⟨⟨RG, η, hRG, hI⟩, hS'⟩

+    (hI : IsIso (RG.unit.app ((EA.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))) :

+    RG.functor RG.unit (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))

+      k.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫

+    infer_instance
+  letI := h

+    (F : A ⥤ B) (V : B ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [V.Additive]
+    (RF : RightImage F) (DV : ExactImage V)
+    (H : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory D)
+    (α β : RF.functor ⋙ DV.functor ⟶ H)
+    (h : ∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
+      DV.functor.map (RF.unit.app K) ≫ α.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
+        DV.functor.map (RF.unit.app K) ≫ β.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) : α = β := by
+  let η : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙ DV.functor ⟶
+      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (RF.functor ⋙ DV.functor) :=
+    Functor.whiskerRight RF.unit DV.functor
+  have hd : (CochainComplex.KInjectives.localizerMorphism A).Derives
+      (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ DV.functor) := by
+    intro K L g hg
+    haveI : IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map
+        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g.hom)) := CategoryTheory.derives F g hg
+    exact DV.functor.map_isIso
+      (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map g.hom))
+  letI : (RF.functor ⋙ DV.functor).IsRightDerivedFunctor η
+      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ)) := by
+    apply hd.isRightDerivedFunctor_of_isIso η
+    intro K
+    haveI := RF.computes K.obj K.property
+    change IsIso (DV.functor.map (RF.unit.app K.obj))
+    infer_instance
+  apply Functor.rightDerived_ext (RF.functor ⋙ DV.functor) η
+    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ)) H α β
+  ext K
+  exact h K

+    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ A] [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ B]
+    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ C] [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ D]

+  letI : EA'.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _

+    ((EB'.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J)

+private def normalizedSquare [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A]
+    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : C ⥤ D) (U : A ⥤ C) (V : B ⥤ D)
+    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [U.Additive] [V.Additive]
+    (RF : RightImage F) (RG : RightImage G) (DU : ExactImage U) (DV : ExactImage V)
+    (e : F ⋙ V ≅ U ⋙ G)
+    (hG : ∀ I : CochainComplex A ℤ, I.IsKInjective →
+      IsIso (RG.unit.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I))) :
+    Square F G U V RF RG DU DV := by
+  let H := CategoryTheory.derivedCoefficientComparison F G U V
+    DU.functor DV.functor DU.factors DV.factors RF.functor RG.functor RF.unit RG.unit
+    RF.computes hG e
+  let k := Classical.choose H
+  have hk := (Classical.choose_spec H).1
+  refine ⟨e, k, ?_⟩
+  intro K
+  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ DV.factors.hom.app
+      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫ q ≫
+        RG.functor.map (DU.factors.hom.app K)) (hk K)
+  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, ← RG.functor.map_comp,
+    Iso.inv_hom_id_app] at h
+  erw [RG.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id] at h
+  exact h

+private theorem square_normalization
+    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : C ⥤ D) (U : A ⥤ C) (V : B ⥤ D)
+    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [U.Additive] [V.Additive]
+    (RF : RightImage F) (RG : RightImage G) (DU : ExactImage U) (DV : ExactImage V)
+    (S : Square F G U V RF RG DU DV) (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
+    DV.functor.map (RF.unit.app K) ≫ S.comparison.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
+      DV.factors.hom.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
+        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex S.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app K) ≫
+        RG.unit.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
+        RG.functor.map (DU.factors.inv.app K) := by
+  apply (cancel_mono (RG.functor.map (DU.factors.hom.app K))).mp
+  rw [Category.assoc, S.normalization]
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← RG.functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
+  erw [RG.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

+private theorem exactComposition_inv
+    (F : A ⥤ B) (V : B ⥤ D) (H : A ⥤ D)
+    [F.Additive] [V.Additive] [H.Additive]
+    (DH : ExactImage H) (DF : ExactImage F) (DV : ExactImage V)
+    (P : ExactComposition F V H DH DF DV) (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
+    DH.factors.inv.app K ≫ P.comparison.inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
+      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex P.ordinary (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
+        DV.factors.inv.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
+        DV.functor.map (DF.factors.inv.app K) := by
+  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫
+      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex P.ordinary (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
+      DV.factors.inv.app ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
+      DV.functor.map (DF.factors.inv.app K)) (P.normalization K)
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← DerivedCategory.Q.map_comp_assoc,
+    Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp,
+    Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, ← DV.functor.map_comp, Category.comp_id] at h
+  erw [DerivedCategory.Q.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
+    ← DV.functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, DV.functor.map_id] at h
+  apply (cancel_epi
+    (P.comparison.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫ DH.factors.hom.app K)).mp
+  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,
+    Category.comp_id, Functor.comp_obj] using h.symm

+private theorem square_identity [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A]
+    (F : A ⥤ B) (U : A ⥤ A) (V : B ⥤ B)
+    [F.Additive] [U.Additive] [V.Additive]
+    (RF : RightImage F) (DU : ExactImage U) (DV : ExactImage V)
+    (S : Square F F U V RF RF DU DV)
+    (iU : ExactIdentity U DU) (iV : ExactIdentity V DV)
+    (hord : S.ordinary.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight iU.ordinary.hom F =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft F iV.ordinary.hom) :
+    S.comparison.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight iU.comparison.hom RF.functor =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft RF.functor iV.comparison.hom := by
+  apply postExact_ext F V RF DV RF.functor
+  intro K
+  dsimp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
+    Functor.comp_obj]
+  rw [← Category.assoc, square_normalization F F U V RF RF DU DV S K]
+  rw [iU.normalization]
+  rw [RF.functor.map_comp]
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← RF.functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app,
+    Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
+  have hn := RF.unit.naturality
+    ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex iU.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app K)
+  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map] at hn
+  erw [RF.functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
+  erw [← hn]
+  have hh := congrArg (fun τ ↦
+    (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex τ (.up ℤ)).app K) hord
+  have hv := iV.comparison.hom.naturality (RF.unit.app K)
+  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_obj] at hv
+  erw [hv, iV.normalization]
+  simp only [Category.assoc]
+  congr 1
+  erw [← Category.assoc, ← DerivedCategory.Q.map_comp]
+  congr 2
+
+end AbstractSquare

+  [Category.{av} A₀] [Category.{av} A₁] [Category.{av} A₂]
+  [Category.{av} B₀] [Category.{av} B₁] [Category.{av} B₂]
+  [Abelian A₀] [Abelian A₁] [Abelian A₂]
+  [Abelian B₀] [Abelian B₁] [Abelian B₂]
+  [HasDerivedCategory.{d} A₀] [HasDerivedCategory.{d} A₁] [HasDerivedCategory.{d} A₂]
+  [HasDerivedCategory.{d} B₀] [HasDerivedCategory.{d} B₁] [HasDerivedCategory.{d} B₂]

+private theorem square_composition [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A₀]
+    (F₀ : A₀ ⥤ B₀) (F₁ : A₁ ⥤ B₁) (F₂ : A₂ ⥤ B₂)
+    (U₀₁ : A₀ ⥤ A₁) (U₁₂ : A₁ ⥤ A₂) (U₀₂ : A₀ ⥤ A₂)
+    (V₀₁ : B₀ ⥤ B₁) (V₁₂ : B₁ ⥤ B₂) (V₀₂ : B₀ ⥤ B₂)
+    [F₀.Additive] [F₁.Additive] [F₂.Additive]
+    [U₀₁.Additive] [U₁₂.Additive] [U₀₂.Additive]
+    [V₀₁.Additive] [V₁₂.Additive] [V₀₂.Additive]
+    (RF₀ : RightImage F₀) (RF₁ : RightImage F₁) (RF₂ : RightImage F₂)
+    (DU₀₁ : ExactImage U₀₁) (DU₁₂ : ExactImage U₁₂) (DU₀₂ : ExactImage U₀₂)
+    (DV₀₁ : ExactImage V₀₁) (DV₁₂ : ExactImage V₁₂) (DV₀₂ : ExactImage V₀₂)
+    (S₀₁ : Square F₀ F₁ U₀₁ V₀₁ RF₀ RF₁ DU₀₁ DV₀₁)
+    (S₁₂ : Square F₁ F₂ U₁₂ V₁₂ RF₁ RF₂ DU₁₂ DV₁₂)
+    (S₀₂ : Square F₀ F₂ U₀₂ V₀₂ RF₀ RF₂ DU₀₂ DV₀₂)
+    (PU : ExactComposition U₀₁ U₁₂ U₀₂ DU₀₂ DU₀₁ DU₁₂)
+    (PV : ExactComposition V₀₁ V₁₂ V₀₂ DV₀₂ DV₀₁ DV₁₂)
+    (hord : S₀₂.ordinary.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight PU.ordinary.inv F₂ =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft F₀ PV.ordinary.inv ≫
+        Functor.whiskerRight S₀₁.ordinary.hom V₁₂ ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft U₀₁ S₁₂.ordinary.hom) :
+    S₀₂.comparison.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight PU.comparison.inv RF₂.functor =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft RF₀.functor PV.comparison.inv ≫
+        Functor.whiskerRight S₀₁.comparison.hom DV₁₂.functor ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft DU₀₁.functor S₁₂.comparison.hom := by
+  apply postExact_ext F₀ V₀₂ RF₀ DV₀₂
+  intro K
+  dsimp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
+    Functor.comp_obj]
+  have hU := exactComposition_inv U₀₁ U₁₂ U₀₂ DU₀₂ DU₀₁ DU₁₂ PU K
+  have hV := exactComposition_inv V₀₁ V₁₂ V₀₂ DV₀₂ DV₀₁ DV₁₂ PV
+    ((F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
+  have hV' := congrArg
+    (DV₀₂.factors.hom.app ((F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫ ·) hV
+  simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.id_comp] at hV'
+  have hnU := RF₂.unit.naturality
+    ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex PU.ordinary (.up ℤ)).inv.app K)
+  have hnV := PV.comparison.inv.naturality (RF₀.unit.app K)
+  have hnS := S₁₂.comparison.hom.naturality (DU₀₁.factors.inv.app K)
+  have hnD := DV₁₂.factors.inv.naturality
+    ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex S₀₁.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app K)
+  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.comp_obj] at hnU hnV hnS hnD
+  have hh := congrArg
+    (fun τ ↦ (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex τ (.up ℤ)).app K) hord
+  rw [← Category.assoc, square_normalization F₀ F₂ U₀₂ V₀₂ RF₀ RF₂ DU₀₂ DV₀₂ S₀₂ K]
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← RF₂.functor.map_comp]
+  rw [hU]
+  simp only [RF₂.functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
+  rw [← reassoc_of% hnU]
+  rw [reassoc_of% hnV, hV']
+  simp only [Category.assoc]
+  rw [← DV₁₂.functor.map_comp_assoc (DV₀₁.functor.map (RF₀.unit.app K))
+    (S₀₁.comparison.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)),
+    square_normalization F₀ F₁ U₀₁ V₀₁ RF₀ RF₁ DU₀₁ DV₀₁ S₀₁ K]
+  simp only [DV₁₂.functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
+  rw [← DV₁₂.functor.map_comp_assoc
+    (DV₀₁.factors.inv.app ((F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))
+    (DV₀₁.factors.hom.app ((F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
+    DV₀₁.factors.inv_hom_id_app]
+  erw [DV₁₂.functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
+  erw [hnS]
+  rw [reassoc_of% (square_normalization F₁ F₂ U₁₂ V₁₂ RF₁ RF₂ DU₁₂ DV₁₂ S₁₂
+    ((U₀₁.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))]
+  erw [← reassoc_of% hnD]
+  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
+  simp only [← DerivedCategory.Q.map_comp_assoc]
+  change (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex S₀₂.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
+      (F₂.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
+        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex PU.ordinary (.up ℤ)).inv.app K) =
+    (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex PV.ordinary (.up ℤ)).inv.app
+        ((F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
+      (V₁₂.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
+        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex S₀₁.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app K) ≫
+      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex S₁₂.ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app
+        ((U₀₁.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) at hh
+  erw [hh]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem square_composition_of_squares [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions A₀]
+    {F₀ : A₀ ⥤ B₀} {F₁ : A₁ ⥤ B₁} {F₂ : A₂ ⥤ B₂}
+    {U₀₁ : A₀ ⥤ A₁} {U₁₂ : A₁ ⥤ A₂} {U₀₂ : A₀ ⥤ A₂}
+    {V₀₁ : B₀ ⥤ B₁} {V₁₂ : B₁ ⥤ B₂} {V₀₂ : B₀ ⥤ B₂}
+    [F₀.Additive] [F₁.Additive] [F₂.Additive]
+    [U₀₁.Additive] [U₁₂.Additive] [U₀₂.Additive]
+    [V₀₁.Additive] [V₁₂.Additive] [V₀₂.Additive]
+    {RF₀ : RightImage F₀} {RF₁ : RightImage F₁} {RF₂ : RightImage F₂}
+    {DU₀₁ : ExactImage U₀₁} {DU₁₂ : ExactImage U₁₂} {DU₀₂ : ExactImage U₀₂}
+    {DV₀₁ : ExactImage V₀₁} {DV₁₂ : ExactImage V₁₂} {DV₀₂ : ExactImage V₀₂}
+    (S₀₁ : Square F₀ F₁ U₀₁ V₀₁ RF₀ RF₁ DU₀₁ DV₀₁)
+    (S₁₂ : Square F₁ F₂ U₁₂ V₁₂ RF₁ RF₂ DU₁₂ DV₁₂)
+    (S₀₂ : Square F₀ F₂ U₀₂ V₀₂ RF₀ RF₂ DU₀₂ DV₀₂)
+    (PU : ExactComposition U₀₁ U₁₂ U₀₂ DU₀₂ DU₀₁ DU₁₂)
+    (PV : ExactComposition V₀₁ V₁₂ V₀₂ DV₀₂ DV₀₁ DV₁₂)
+    (hord : S₀₂.ordinary.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight PU.ordinary.inv F₂ =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft F₀ PV.ordinary.inv ≫
+        Functor.whiskerRight S₀₁.ordinary.hom V₁₂ ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft U₀₁ S₁₂.ordinary.hom) :
+    S₀₂.comparison.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight PU.comparison.inv RF₂.functor =
+      Functor.whiskerLeft RF₀.functor PV.comparison.inv ≫
+        Functor.whiskerRight S₀₁.comparison.hom DV₁₂.functor ≫
+        Functor.whiskerLeft DU₀₁.functor S₁₂.comparison.hom := by
+  exact square_composition F₀ F₁ F₂ U₀₁ U₁₂ U₀₂ V₀₁ V₁₂ V₀₂
+    RF₀ RF₁ RF₂ DU₀₁ DU₁₂ DU₀₂ DV₀₁ DV₁₂ DV₀₂ S₀₁ S₁₂ S₀₂ PU PV hord
+
+end Composition

+private theorem push_restricted_computes {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    (B S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
+    (T : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
+    (hB : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : B.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hS : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : S.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hT : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : T.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (a : B ⟶ S) (p : T ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B)
+    (RG : RightImage (push f p))
+    (I : CochainComplex (Mod X S) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective) :
+    IsIso (RG.unit.app
+      (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{max u (t + 1)} a).mapHomologicalComplex
+        (.up ℤ)).obj I)) := by
+  let EA := smallModules X B
+  let ES := smallModules X S
+  let EB := smallModules Y T
+  letI : EA.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  letI : ES.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  letI : EB.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  letI : ES.inverse.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
+  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (smallBaseChange.{t, u} f) := by
+    letI : (AsSmall.down : smallSite.{t, u} Y ⥤ Y.ProEt).IsEquivalence :=
+      inferInstanceAs (AsSmall.equiv.{t, t + 1, max u (t + 1)}
+        (C := Y.ProEt)).inverse.IsEquivalence
+    letI : (AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ smallSite.{t, u} X).IsEquivalence :=
+      inferInstanceAs (AsSmall.equiv.{t, t + 1, max u (t + 1)}
+        (C := X.ProEt)).functor.IsEquivalence
+    dsimp only [smallBaseChange]
+    infer_instance
+  letI : RepresentablyFlat (smallBaseChange.{t, u} f) := flat_of_preservesFiniteLimits _
+  let a' := ((AsSmall.down : smallSite.{t, u} X ⥤ X.ProEt).sheafPushforwardContinuous
+    RingCat.{max u (t + 1)} (smallTopology X) (ProEt.topology X)).map a
+  obtain ⟨RS, hRS⟩ := continuousAcyclicDerived (smallBaseChange.{t, u} f)
+    (smallRing X B) (smallRing X S) (smallRing Y T)
+    (fun U ↦ hB (AsSmall.down.op.obj U))
+    (fun U ↦ hS (AsSmall.down.op.obj U))
+    (fun U ↦ hT (AsSmall.down.op.obj U)) a' (smallStructure f p)
+  letI := hI
+  have hJ : CochainComplex.IsKInjective
+      ((ES.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) := by
+    letI : ES.symm.functor.Additive := by change ES.inverse.Additive; infer_instance
+    letI : ES.symm.inverse.Additive := by change ES.functor.Additive; infer_instance
+    letI := ES.symm.toAdjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes
+    infer_instance
+  apply computes_of_equivalence EA EB (push f p)
+    (SheafOfModules.pushforward (smallStructure f p)) RG RS (smallPushSquare f p)
+  apply computes_on_iso _ RS
+    ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (smallRestrictionSquare X a) (.up ℤ)).app I)
+  exact hRS ((ES.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I) hJ

+private def ordinarySquare {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    {B B' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    {C C' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    (b : B ⟶ B') (c : C ⟶ C')
+    (p : C ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B)
+    (q : C' ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B')
+    (h : c ≫ q = p ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map b) :
+    push f q ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars c ≅
+      SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b ⋙ push f p :=
+  SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp
+      (F := 𝟭 Y.ProEt) (G := proEtaleBaseChange f) c q ≪≫
+    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (F := proEtaleBaseChange f) (S := C) (R := B') h ≪≫
+    (SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp
+      (F := proEtaleBaseChange f) (G := 𝟭 X.ProEt) p b).symm
+

+private theorem finiteStructure_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
+    quotientMap l E Y h ≫ finiteStructure l E f n =
+      finiteStructure l E f m ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map (quotientMap l E X h) := by
+  let η : integralCoefficientSheafSystem l E Y ⟶
+      integralCoefficientSheafSystem l E X ⋙ ringPush.{t, u} f :=
+    NatTrans.ofOpSequence (fun n ↦ finiteStructure l E f n) (by
+      intro n
+      simp only [Functor.comp_map, integralCoefficientSheafSystem,
+        Functor.ofOpSequence_map_homOfLE_succ]
+      exact (finiteStructure_transition f l E n).symm)
+  exact η.naturality (homOfLE h).op

+private def coefficientSquare {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    {B B' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    {C C' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    (hB : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : B.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hB' : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : B'.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hC : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : C.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (b : B ⟶ B') (c : C ⟶ C')
+    (p : C ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B)
+    (q : C' ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B')
+    (h : c ≫ q = p ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map b)
+    (RF : RightImage (push f q)) (RG : RightImage (push f p))
+    (DU : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b))
+    (DV : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars c)) :
+    Square (push f q) (push f p)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars c) RF RG DU DV := by
+  exact normalizedSquare _ _ _ _ RF RG DU DV (ordinarySquare f b c p q h)
+    (fun I hI ↦ push_restricted_computes f B B' C hB hB' hC b p RG I hI)

+private theorem coefficientSquare_sections {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    {B B' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    {C C' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    (hB : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : B.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hB' : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : B'.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (hC : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : C.obj.obj U), a * b = b * a)
+    (b : B ⟶ B') (c : C ⟶ C')
+    (p : C ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B)
+    (q : C' ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B')
+    (h : c ≫ q = p ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map b)
+    (RF : RightImage (push f q)) (RG : RightImage (push f p))
+    (DU : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b))
+    (DV : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars c)) :
+    IsSectionwiseIdentity Y C
+      (coefficientSquare f hB hB' hC b c p q h RF RG DU DV).ordinary.hom := by
+  exact ordinarySquare_sections f b c p q h

+private theorem finiteIso_unique (W : Scheme.{t}) (s : SiteCoefficientData l E W) (n : ℕ) :
+    s.finiteIso n = finiteCoefficientIso l E W n := by
+  let B := SheafOfModules.coefficientQuotientSheaf (J := ProEt.topology W)
+    (systemRing.{t, u} l E) (systemUniformizer.{t, u} l E) n
+  let T := (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).obj
+    (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))
+  let V := sheafCompose (ProEt.topology W)
+    (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
+  let a : B ⟶ T :=
+    ⟨{ app := fun U ↦ CommRingCat.ofHom ((s.finiteIso n).hom.hom.app U).hom
+       naturality := by
+         intro U U' g
+         apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
+         exact congrArg RingCat.Hom.hom ((s.finiteIso n).hom.hom.naturality g) }⟩
+  let a₀ : B ⟶ T :=
+    (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).map
+      (finiteCoefficientEquiv.{t, u} l E n).toCommRingCatIso.hom
+  have hh : a = a₀ := by
+    apply ((sheafificationAdjunction (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).homEquiv
+      ((Functor.const W.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
+        (CommRingCat.of (systemRing.{t, u} l E ⧸
+          (Ideal.span ({systemUniformizer.{t, u} l E} : Set (systemRing.{t, u} l E))) ^
+            (n + 1)))) T).injective
+    ext U x
+    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
+    exact (s.finiteIso_generator n U x).trans
+      (finiteCoefficientIso_generator l E W n U x).symm
+  apply Iso.ext
+  change V.map a = V.map a₀
+  exact congrArg V.map hh

+private def directSystems {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
+    Systems l E X ⥤ Systems l E Y where
+  obj M := {
+    level := fun n ↦ (push f (rawStructure l E f n)).obj (M.level n)
+    transition := fun n ↦
+      (push f (rawStructure l E f (n + 1))).map (M.transition n) ≫
+        (rawSquare l E f (Nat.le_succ n)).inv.app (M.level n) }
+  map {M N} g := {
+    app := fun n ↦ (push f (rawStructure l E f n)).map (g.app n)
+    comm := by
+      intro n

+private theorem section_square_composition {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    {B₀ B₁ B₂ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    {T₀ T₁ T₂ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) RingCat.{max u (t + 1)}}
+    (p₀ : T₀ ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B₀)
+    (p₁ : T₁ ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B₁)
+    (p₂ : T₂ ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj B₂)
+    (a₀₁ : B₁ ⟶ B₀) (a₁₂ : B₂ ⟶ B₁) (a₀₂ : B₂ ⟶ B₀)
+    (b₀₁ : T₁ ⟶ T₀) (b₁₂ : T₂ ⟶ T₁) (b₀₂ : T₂ ⟶ T₀)
+    (RF₀ : RightImage (push f p₀)) (RF₁ : RightImage (push f p₁))
+    (RF₂ : RightImage (push f p₂))
+    (DU₀₁ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₁))
+    (DU₁₂ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₁₂))
+    (DU₀₂ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₂))
+    (DV₀₁ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₁))
+    (DV₁₂ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₁₂))
+    (DV₀₂ : ExactImage (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₂))
+    (S₀₁ : Square (push f p₀) (push f p₁)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₁) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₁)
+      RF₀ RF₁ DU₀₁ DV₀₁)
+    (S₁₂ : Square (push f p₁) (push f p₂)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₁₂) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₁₂)
+      RF₁ RF₂ DU₁₂ DV₁₂)
+    (S₀₂ : Square (push f p₀) (push f p₂)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₂) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₂)
+      RF₀ RF₂ DU₀₂ DV₀₂)
+    (PU : ExactComposition (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₁)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₁₂) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₂)
+      DU₀₂ DU₀₁ DU₁₂)
+    (PV : ExactComposition (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₁)
+      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₁₂) (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars b₀₂)
+      DV₀₂ DV₀₁ DV₁₂)
+    (h₀₁ : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y T₁ S₀₁.ordinary.hom)
+    (h₁₂ : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y T₂ S₁₂.ordinary.hom)
+    (h₀₂ : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y T₂ S₀₂.ordinary.hom)
+    (hU : IsSectionwiseIdentity X B₂ PU.ordinary.hom)
+    (hV : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y T₂ PV.ordinary.hom)
+    (K : DerivedCategory (Mod X B₀)) :
+    S₀₂.comparison.hom.app K ≫ RF₂.functor.map (PU.comparison.inv.app K) =
+      PV.comparison.inv.app (RF₀.functor.obj K) ≫
+        DV₁₂.functor.map (S₀₁.comparison.hom.app K) ≫
+        S₁₂.comparison.hom.app (DU₀₁.functor.obj K) := by
+  apply NatTrans.congr_app (square_composition_of_squares S₀₁ S₁₂ S₀₂ PU PV ?_) K
+  apply sectionIdentity_unique (W := Y) (B := T₂)
+  · exact sectionIdentity_comp h₀₂
+      (sectionIdentity_push f p₂ (sectionIdentity_inverse PU.ordinary hU))
+  · exact sectionIdentity_comp
+      (fun M ↦ sectionIdentity_inverse PV.ordinary hV ((push f p₀).obj M))
+      (sectionIdentity_comp (sectionIdentity_restrict b₁₂ h₀₁)
+        (fun M ↦ h₁₂ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars a₀₁).obj M)))

+private def coefficientComparisonOfSections {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    (C : CoefficientImageData l E f)
+    (hS0 : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (A l E Y) C.constantSquare.ordinary.hom)
+    (hSN : ∀ n, IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (R l E Y) (C.finiteSquare n).ordinary.hom)
+    (hSQ : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
+      IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (N l E Y m) (C.quotientSquare h).ordinary.hom) :
+    CoefficientComparisonData l E f := by
+  let source := C.source
+  let target := C.target
+  let c := C.structureMap
+  let RC := C.completedImage
+  let RN := C.finiteImage
+  let SN := C.finiteSquare
+  let SQ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) := C.quotientSquare h
+  have hqid (n : ℕ) := square_identity (push f (finiteStructure l E f n))
+    (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (quotientMap l E X (le_refl n)))
+    (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (quotientMap l E Y (le_refl n)))
+    (RN n) (source.restriction (le_refl n)) (target.restriction (le_refl n))
+    (SQ (le_refl n)) (source.restrictionIdentity n) (target.restrictionIdentity n) (by
+      apply sectionIdentity_unique (W := Y) (B := N l E Y n)
+      · exact sectionIdentity_comp (hSQ (le_refl n))
+          (sectionIdentity_push f (finiteStructure l E f n)
+            (source.restrictionIdentity_sections n))
+      · intro M U x
+        exact target.restrictionIdentity_sections n
+          ((push f (finiteStructure l E f n)).obj M) U x)
+  have hqcomp {k m n : ℕ} (hkm : m ≤ k) (hmn : n ≤ m) :=
+    section_square_composition f
+      (B₀ := N l E X n) (B₁ := N l E X m) (B₂ := N l E X k)
+      (T₀ := N l E Y n) (T₁ := N l E Y m) (T₂ := N l E Y k)
+      (finiteStructure l E f n) (finiteStructure l E f m) (finiteStructure l E f k)
+      (quotientMap l E X hmn) (quotientMap l E X hkm) (quotientMap l E X (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (quotientMap l E Y hmn) (quotientMap l E Y hkm) (quotientMap l E Y (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (RN n) (RN m) (RN k)
+      (source.restriction hmn) (source.restriction hkm) (source.restriction (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (target.restriction hmn) (target.restriction hkm) (target.restriction (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (SQ hmn) (SQ hkm) (SQ (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (source.restrictionComposition hkm hmn) (target.restrictionComposition hkm hmn)
+      (hSQ hmn) (hSQ hkm) (hSQ (hmn.trans hkm))
+      (source.restrictionComposition_identity hkm hmn)
+      (target.restrictionComposition_identity hkm hmn)
+  have hpcomp {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :=
+    section_square_composition f
+      (B₀ := N l E X n) (B₁ := N l E X m) (B₂ := R l E X)
+      (T₀ := N l E Y n) (T₁ := N l E Y m) (T₂ := R l E Y)
+      (finiteStructure l E f n) (finiteStructure l E f m) c
+      (quotientMap l E X h) (projection l E X m) (projection l E X n)
+      (quotientMap l E Y h) (projection l E Y m) (projection l E Y n)
+      (RN n) (RN m) RC
+      (source.restriction h) (source.V m) (source.V n)
+      (target.restriction h) (target.V m) (target.V n)
+      (SQ h) (SN m) (SN n) (source.projectionComposition h) (target.projectionComposition h)
+      (hSQ h) (hSN m) (hSN n)
+      (source.projectionComposition_identity h) (target.projectionComposition_identity h)
+  exact {
+    toCoefficientImageData := C
+    constantOrdinary_identity := hS0
+    finiteOrdinary_identity := hSN
+    quotientOrdinary_identity := hSQ
+    quotientIdentity := fun n K ↦ NatTrans.congr_app (hqid n) K
+    quotientCoherence := fun hkm hmn K ↦ hqcomp hkm hmn K
+    projectionCoherence := by
+      intro m n h K
+      have hh := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫
+        RC.functor.map ((source.projectionComposition h).comparison.hom.app K))
+        (hpcomp h K)
+      simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app,
+        Functor.comp_obj, Category.assoc, ← RC.functor.map_comp,
+        Iso.inv_hom_id_app] at hh
+      erw [RC.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id] at hh
+      exact hh }

+private theorem coefficientComparisons_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    (source : SiteData l E X) (target : SiteData l E Y)
+    (c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X))

+    ∃ D : CoefficientComparisonData l E f,
+      D.source = source ∧ D.target = target ∧ D.structureMap = c := by
+  classical
+  let RC := Classical.choice (rightImage_exists (push f c))
+  let RA := Classical.choice (rightImage_exists (push f (constantStructure l E f)))
+  let RN (n : ℕ) := Classical.choice
+    (rightImage_exists (push f (finiteStructure l E f n)))
+  have hA (W : Scheme.{t}) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (a b : (A l E W).obj.obj U) :

+      (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).obj
+        (CommRingCat.of (systemRing.{t, u} l E))).obj.obj U).commRing
+    exact mul_comm a b
+  have hN (W : Scheme.{t}) (n : ℕ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)

+    letI : CommRing ((N l E W n).obj.obj U) :=
+      (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).obj
+        (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1}
+          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))).obj.obj U).commRing
+    exact mul_comm a b
+  let S0 := coefficientSquare f
+    (B := A l E X) (B' := R l E X) (C := A l E Y) (C' := R l E Y) (hA X)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E X) (hA Y)
+    (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X)
+    (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E Y)
+    (constantStructure l E f) c hconstant RC RA source.U target.U
+  let SN (n : ℕ) := coefficientSquare f
+    (B := R l E X) (B' := N l E X n) (C := R l E Y) (C' := N l E Y n)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E X) (hN X n)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E Y)
+    (projection l E X n) (projection l E Y n) c (finiteStructure l E f n)
+    (hc n).symm (RN n) RC (source.V n) (target.V n)
+  let SQ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) := coefficientSquare f
+    (B := N l E X m) (B' := N l E X n) (C := N l E Y m) (C' := N l E Y n)
+    (hN X m) (hN X n) (hN Y m)
+    (quotientMap l E X h) (quotientMap l E Y h)
+    (finiteStructure l E f m) (finiteStructure l E f n)
+    (finiteStructure_naturality l E f h) (RN n) (RN m)
+    (source.restriction h) (target.restriction h)
+  let C : CoefficientImageData l E f := {
+    source := source
+    target := target
+    structureMap := c
+    structureProjection := hc
+    completedImage := RC
+    constantImage := RA
+    finiteImage := RN
+    constantSquare := S0
+    finiteSquare := SN
+    quotientSquare := SQ }
+  have hS0 : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (A l E Y) S0.ordinary.hom :=
+    coefficientSquare_sections f
+    (B := A l E X) (B' := R l E X) (C := A l E Y) (C' := R l E Y) (hA X)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E X) (hA Y)
+    (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X)
+    (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E Y)
+    (constantStructure l E f) c hconstant RC RA source.U target.U
+  have hSN (n : ℕ) : IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (R l E Y) (SN n).ordinary.hom :=
+    coefficientSquare_sections f
+    (B := R l E X) (B' := N l E X n) (C := R l E Y) (C' := N l E Y n)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E X) (hN X n)
+    (completedIntegralCoefficient_mul_commUnrestricted l E Y)
+    (projection l E X n) (projection l E Y n) c (finiteStructure l E f n)

+  have hSQ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
+      IsSectionwiseIdentity Y (N l E Y m) (SQ h).ordinary.hom :=
+    coefficientSquare_sections f
+    (B := N l E X m) (B' := N l E X n) (C := N l E Y m) (C' := N l E Y n)

+    (quotientMap l E X h) (quotientMap l E Y h)
+    (finiteStructure l E f m) (finiteStructure l E f n)
+    (finiteStructure_naturality l E f h) (RN n) (RN m)
+    (source.restriction h) (target.restriction h)
